name: XlSlicerSort
description: Specifies whether items displayed in the slicer are sorted, and if they are sorted, whether they are sorted in ascending or descending order by item captions.

constants.name: xlSlicerSortDataSourceOrder
constants.description: Slicer items are displayed in the order provided by the data source.

constants.name: xlSlicerSortAscending
constants.description: Slicer items are sorted in ascending order by item captions.

constants.name: xlSlicerSortDescending
constants.description: Slicer items are sorted in descending order by item captions.
